# BB00384 {.unnumbered}

Praise be to God, Who created the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them by His command—"Be," and it is.

Praise be to God, before Whom bow down all that are in the heavens and on the earth and whatsoever lieth between them, and all worship Him.

Praise be to God, Whom all that are in the heavens and all that are on the earth and whatsoever lieth between them glorify; and all prostrate themselves before Him.

Praise be to God, Whose is the sovereignty of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them; and all are obedient unto Him.

Praise be to God, in Whose grasp is the kingdom of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them; and all have knowledge through Him.

Praise be to God, in Whose right hand is all glory, from before and from after; and all are brought low before Him.

Praise be to God, Whose are creation and command; and all are humbled before Him.

Praise be to God, Whose is the primal origination of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them; and unto Him shall all return.

Praise be to God, Whose is the judgment of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them; and unto Him shall all be brought back.

Praise be to God, Whose is the light of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them; and by His light are all illumined.

Praise be to God, Whose is the bounty of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them; and of His bounty do all ask.

Praise be to God, Whose are the hosts of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them; and by His hosts do all prevail.

Praise be to God, Whose are the treasuries of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them; and in His path do all expend.

Praise be to God, Whose are the keys of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them; and by His command do all judge.

Praise be to God, Whose are the keys of the unseen in the kingdom of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them; and from what He hath sent down in the Book do all learn.

Praise be to God, Who bringeth into being whatsoever He willeth by His command, and all create by His behest.

Praise be to God, Who hath revealed in the Book the pilgrimage to the House for those who believe in Him with certitude.

Praise be to God, Who knoweth whatsoever is in the heavens and on the earth and whatsoever lieth between them; and all submit unto Him.

Praise be to God, Who ordaineth the creation of all things according to a measured decree.

Praise be to God, Whose mercy hath preceded whomsoever He willeth among all that are in the heavens and on the earth and whatsoever lieth between them; and unto what is with God do all yearn.

Praise be to God, Who bestoweth His bounty upon whomsoever He willeth of His servants; and all give thanks unto Him.

Praise be to God, by Whose leave act all that are in the kingdom of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them; and before His dread do all tremble.

Praise be to God, Who hath established Himself upon the Throne, ordering the affair from heaven unto earth; all stand before Him.

Praise be to God, Whose is the beauty of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them; and by the remembrance of God do all seek exaltation.

Praise be to God, Whom none can remember with a remembrance worthy of Him, nor worship with such worship as He hath borne witness unto His own Self. And by His command are all sustained; and by His command are all forgiven; and by His command do all live; and unto God shall all be presented. And Him do all magnify; and Him do all sanctify; and Him do all extol.

Praise be to God, Whose is whatsoever is in the heavens and on the earth and whatsoever lieth between them; and before Him do all prostrate themselves.

Praise be to God, Who forgiveth whomsoever He willeth of His servants; and verily we all turn repentant unto Him.
